introduction: Explore the abandoned mansion's clues, secret cellar and smuggler cave. Five recorded exchanges take place in the Tower of Darkness: free Azlion, report Joseph's fate, assemble Darrin's Star Key and carry Isabia's ring to Danthas. These Tower requests currently appear in this mansion's journal.
orientation: This is Braddistock Mansion (brad), entered from Tharnadia's sea wall onto the short rocky road. It is separate from the older Braddistock area. The spirit on the road blocks ordinary northward entry above level 14; trusted staff bypass that rule. No quest hand-in opens this gate.

Inspect the entrance-floor tracks and the mansion's rooms. The library's closed tome contains a note pointing beyond the skeletons. OPEN the tome and GET the note; reading that clue is useful guidance, without a recorded learned-topic achievement.

The scratched key on the main bedroom floor fits the southern bedroom door. Ned Shakeshaft waits beyond it with his dagger; no native request or rescue reward is attached to him. Closed chests and furniture contain ordinary supplies and treasures, distinct from accepted quest outcomes.

Search the secret southern cellar door, then inspect and open the eastern barred door toward the skeleton room. Search the next secret eastern door to reach the laboratory. These are real exit and door routes, with normal search, lock and combat requirements; the journal does not record their discovery or traversal as completed stages.

The laboratory's alchemy book, golden skull, apple, rose and set of five weights tell an alchemist's story. The weights are one treasure object. The alchemist’s skeleton container holds the pebble, and tables hold scrolls. No bound alchemy conversion or laboratory finale was found; a book or pebble is not proof of performing one.

Sanbalet and the smugglers occupy the lower caverns with brandy kegs and silk bolts. These are treasure items, not a named turn-in. The glowing boat is an ordinary boat in the sea cave; the current cave has no exit to the sea or implemented smuggling voyage. Exploration, combat and loot have no authored local quest terminal here.

The five cards below describe requests in the Tower of Darkness. Meeting those givers in the Tower does not itself open this mansion's journal; visit the mansion to discover it. Consult the Tower's own journal for its access requests. Some givers leave after a hand-in, and return availability is not guaranteed.

Azlion waits in the Tower's summoning chamber. Ask power, circle, freedom or favour for his staff request, and urian or sargon for the larger threat. The excited conjurer holds the cold-iron staff in the arbysal audience chamber; recover it to loose inventory and give it to Azlion for the Redemption of Light broadsword. Azlion leaves, but the described rift is not spawned by the exchange.

Jenifer waits in the Tower's farmhouse. The ogre mercenary in the foyer carries Joseph Hammerson's decapitated head. Give that exact head to Jenifer for 100,000 experience. Supplying it is accepted without this player's personal kill or first recovery history.

Father Darrin waits in the Church of Holy Light. Ask key, stone, keystone or star. The first through last Star Stone pieces belong to Kinslor, Lord Mordren, Cardinal Faethron, Earlion that Is and Urian Shadowborn. Five different loose pieces are required together; duplicate copies of one piece cannot replace another. Darrin gives the Star Key and leaves.

The Star Key's actual Tower hill, keystone and prison access differs from receiving it. The rift, Sargon battle and return route need their own successful travel and outcome evidence before a campaign can be completed. The current exchange does not prove that Sargon was defeated or that the world was saved.

Ask Isabia key or prison in the Tower's prison room. Cardinal Faethron carries her bone key, which also opens a different chest. Give the exact key to Isabia for her ring; despite her farewell, the native exchange leaves her instance present. Deliver the loose ring to Danthas for bladesinger leggings. His staged starting room and possible wandering make actual encounter availability a separate concern.

Earlier Isabia completion is optional guidance for Danthas; a supplied matching ring is valid. ASK aliases are response topics rather than separate achievements. Current materials, earlier accepted receipts, source recovery, physical access and actual reward completion are distinct facts.

Discovery has its own achievement. Active, ready accounting is required for quest journals, achievements and daily credit. A daily listing does not guarantee that the recipient is present or that fresh materials are available.

stories.title: Break Azlion's binding circle
